overallAssessment: Four of five documents required no edits: docs/research/metadata-catalog/c1-rules-refinement.md (BA fit-gap of prior art, correctly scoped as historical/prior-art analysis, not a shipped-state claim), docs/reviews/SD-DEV-C1-RULES-security-review.md (independent, probe-verified, matches shipped code line references), docs/testing/SD-DEV-C1-RULES-qa-report.md (traceability matrix matches actual test names and shipped behavior; all referenced evidence files resolve; the two renamed .log captures are already correctly linked), and docs/known-limitations.md (the new all-or-nothing section accurately reflects the shipped executor guard). The architecture design doc (docs/architecture/c1-rules-matching-duplicate-design.md) was the one genuinely stale document: it was written and approved before the security-review rework closed finding F1, and its section 6 / file-ownership table no longer matched the as-shipped guard architecture (a new shared module plus two additional consuming files). Per this review's charter, that staleness was corrected in place with an explicit, dated 'Superseded / as shipped' note and additional file-ownership rows rather than being left as a silent contradiction or escalated as a 'changes' disposition, since the correction is a small, verifiable factual alignment and does not change any acceptance-criteria conclusion already reached by the architect/security-review/qa phases.
